=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:149-189 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Judge the blocked item" env block never maps UNBLOCK_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_CLOSE_ENABLED, so the script always uses its default `true`.
  WHY: The documented kill switch (README `false` restores the resume) has no effect in production. Reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:441-456 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: unblock_nothing_to_implement_close() closes the issue based only on the newest "Planning blocked" comment. It does not check `has_plan` or later plan/implement activity.
  WHY: An issue with a plan and an implement-stage block can be closed as completed instead of getting `/approved`. Reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1702-1707 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `unblock_patch_comment ... || true` swallows a failed write that marks the wait comment `done` after the issue is already closed.
  WHY: The wait marker stays stale and is not retried because the issue is closed. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR; the others rated it NIT.
- agents.d/8470-unblock-nothing-to-implement-close.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "At most three writes, no reads" claim (also changelog.d/8470-nothing-to-implement-close-and-heal-create-detail.md:15-16) omits the fourth write, the wait-comment patch to `done`.
  WHY: The documentation understates the write budget. Reviewers rated this NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:452 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The jq exact `Reason:` line match is fragile against future changes to the plan prompt wording.
  WHY: A format change would silently restore the #8470 loop. Rated NIT.
- tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4971 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: MERGED_FIXUP is redefined with an identical value, duplicating the definition at line 3360.
  WHY: The duplicate is harmless but redundant. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Kill switch `UNBLOCK_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_CLOSE_ENABLED` (default `true`), with a README row saying `false` restores the resume.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml, "Judge the blocked item" env block (next to line 174)
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No PR hunk touches .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml, and the env block (lines 147-189) has no mapping for the variable, so it never reaches scripts/unblock_judge.sh:444.
- requirement: "A failed write keeps the wait open, so the next scan retries" (PR description, agents.d fragment line 2, changelog.d fragment line 15).
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_judge.sh call site lines 1700-1708 (post-close `unblock_patch_comment`, line 1703)
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The `|| true` after the close swallows a failed wait-marker patch, so that failure is not retried and the contract is only partly met.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:441-456 (call at ~1701) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: unblock_nothing_to_implement_close() closes as completed on the newest "Planning blocked" comment alone and does not check `has_plan`. The existing resume in scripts/unblock_actions.py (lines 739-742) posts `/approved` when a plan exists.
  WHY: An issue with a plan and an implement-stage block is closed (`ai:closed`) instead of resumed. Fix: pass `${has_plan}` and return 1 when it is true.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1702-1707 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed `unblock_patch_comment ... || true` after the close is ignored.
  WHY: Closed issues are not rescanned, so the wait comment stays stale. The impact is small because the close and the marker comment are already recorded.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:164-189 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: UNBLOCK_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_CLOSE_ENABLED is not mapped in the env block, although the siblings at lines 174-175 are.
  WHY: Setting the repo variable to `false` has no effect, so the documented rollback does not exist.
- agents.d/8470-unblock-nothing-to-implement-close.md and changelog fragment | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: "At most three writes, no reads" is off by one, because the wait-comment patch at ~1702 is a fourth write.
  WHY: Documentation only.
- tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4971 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: MERGED_FIXUP repeats the identical definition at line 3360.
  WHY: Harmless and redundant.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Kill switch `UNBLOCK_NOTHING_TO_IMPLEMENT_CLOSE_ENABLED` (default `true`), plus the README row saying `false` restores the resume. Expected change site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml, env block next to line 174. Evidence of absence: No hunk touches the workflow, which has no occurrence of the variable. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5

  WHY: It does not verify whether later plan or implement activity occurred, so it can wrongly close issues as completed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:1703-1705 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `unblock_patch_comment()` is followed by `|| true`, which swallows an API failure when marking the fix-up wait as done.
  WHY: The "done" marker is not recorded and the wait state stays stale.
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:(not modified) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The kill switch is documented in README.md but never mapped to the script environment.
  WHY: Setting the variable to false has no effect, so the kill switch is unreachable in production.

  WHY: The state is inconsistent, but unblock_scan.py (lines 16-18) only picks open items, so it is not a runtime blocker.
